messages:
sam (infra): Rolling new Dedicated pool in eu-west-1; provisioning keeps failing during node boot. Seeing a ton of RequestLimitExceeded and SecurityGroup rule errors.
raj (cloud-ops): Ugh. Which errors exactly? can you paste logs?
sam (infra): Logs:
```
2026-02-14T09:12:05Z ERROR ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress failed: RequestLimitExceeded
2026-02-14T09:12:06Z ERROR node-init: failed to create ENI: RequestLimitExceeded
```
elaine (sre): We're hitting two separate limits usually: SG rules per SG and EC2 API request rate (CreateNetworkInterface/ModifyNetworkInterface). Both cause bootstrap to fail.
sam (infra): Yep. Cloud console shows the SG in question already has ~130 ingress rules. AWS default is 60 rules per SG in some regions.
mat (eng-prod): Oof. Why did we end up with that many rules? I thought we use shared SGs.
sam (infra): Long history of per-service CIDR additions. New cluster code tries to stamp 30-40 additional CIDRs during boot -> bursts API calls -> throttle.
raj (cloud-ops): I opened a support case. Case ID: 1234567891. Requested:
- Increase EC2 API request rate for our account in eu-west-1 for CreateNetworkInterface/Attach/Modify.
- Increase max rules per security group from 60 -> 200 for the account.
aws-support-bot: Support case 1234567891 submitted. Current ETA for response: 48–72 hours. Recommended immediate mitigations: reduce API burst, consolidate SG rules.
sam (infra): Short-term mitigations we can push now:
- Use prefix-lists for outbound CIDRs (supports referencing a single object instead of many rules).
- Consolidate older rules; rotate stale CIDRs out.
- Add client-side rate limiter in the cluster provisioning controller (e.g., 10 reqs/s backoff).
elaine (sre): Also add exponential backoff for ENI creation and retry logic; that will reduce cascading failures.
mat (eng-prod): Can we change the bootstrap order? Create ENIs after SG rules converge? Right now we parallelize and slam the API.
sam (infra): Good call — I'll patch the controller to apply SG changes first and then create ENIs with a small rate cap.
raj (cloud-ops): AWS replied to the case: "We can provisionally raise the per-SG rule limit to 120 and advise prefix-list adoption. Full API rate increase requires capacity review." They asked for expected sustained RPS and spike patterns.
sam (infra): I'll dump our spike metrics: we had 220 CreateNetworkInterface attempts over 30s during parallel provisioning.
elaine (sre): Interim policy: limit parallel node launches to 8 per provisioning job.
mat (eng-prod): Can we also add a post-provision job that dedupes and collapses SG rules into a smaller set? Run after cluster healthy.
sam (infra): Yep. Plan:
1) Patch controller for ordered apply + rate limiter (sam)
2) Limit parallel node launches to 8 (elaine)
3) Run SG dedupe job and start using prefix-lists (raj)
4) Monitor support case and escalate if needed (sam / raj)

sam (infra): Also adding this ASG bootstrap snippet for rate limit (example):
```
# pseudo
for nic in nic_list:
  backoff(retry=5) {
    aws ec2 create-network-interface --subnet $subnet --groups sg-xxx
  }
  sleep 0.12 # before next nic
}
```
raj (cloud-ops): FYI: For long-term, consider using a VPC endpoint-based architecture and fewer security groups, or move to managed prefix-lists for third-party CIDRs.
aws-support-bot: Case 1234567891 updated: Support increased per-security-group rule limit to 120; monitoring in place. Further API rate changes pending capacity review.
elaine (sre): Thanks. After we roll the controller change, let's run a canary create of 16 nodes and watch for RequestLimitExceeded.
mat (eng-prod): I'll schedule a low-traffic canary for tonight at 22:00 UTC.
sam (infra): I'll open an internal postmortem note after canary. Quick win: we'll also add telemetry to count SG rule creations per cluster so we don't regress.
elaine (sre): Nice. @raj can you link the support case and the quota increase confirmation in the incident tracker?
raj (cloud-ops): Done: https://tickets.internal/INC-2026-042
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: infra/controller#184; ETA 15m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
sam (infra): Rolling now. I'll post updates.
